---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest new physics, an API addition, or another enhancement
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What problem would this solve?**
A description of the use case this feature would unlock or simplify (e.g. a
physical effect you can't currently model, an ergonomics pain point, a
performance need).

**Describe the feature you'd like**
As concrete a description as you can give — new arguments, new propagator,
new example, etc.

**Backwards compatibility**
Deepwave's public API (the four propagators, their Module forms, `wavelets`,
`location_interpolation`, `IGNORE_LOCATION`) is expected to stay
backwards-compatible: existing calls should keep working unchanged. If your
request implies a behaviour change to something that already exists, please
say so explicitly — additive, opt-in changes are much easier to accept.

**Alternatives you've considered**
Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.

**Additional context**
Links to relevant papers, other software's implementation, or related
discussion (e.g. an entry in `IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md` if you've checked it).
